Harper (Docs): Quick flag: preview for PR 8122 is erroring on the playground examples. the generated dashboard preview returns a 500 with `KeyError: 'cost_summary'`.
Dmitri (Eng-Obs): That field was collapsed into `summary.cost` in the telemetry flattening change. docs examples still reference the old `cost_summary`.
Nora (SDK): I missed a handful of README snippets when I cut the release. I'll push a tiny PR to update Node/Python examples and add an explicit backward-compat note.
Harper (Docs): Could we also add a short one-liner showing the YAML diff customers can copy? Makes migrations easier.
Nora (SDK): Adding diff in the migration guide, e.g.:
```diff
- cost_summary:
-   total: 123
-   breakdown: { cpu: 100, gpu: 23 }
+ summary:
+   cost:
+     total: 123
+     breakdown: { cpu: 100, gpu: 23 }
```
Samir (Platform): Small ops ask: the docs site index still contains redirects to `/console/obsv/cost_summary` from an older page. please remove that redirect so search doesn't show stale examples.
Dmitri (Eng-Obs): I'll open a follow-up to prune the redirect file and add a changelog bullet. we can keep a temporary server-side alias for 2 weeks.
Jules (QA): Once the snippets are updated can someone paste the curl i'll use for the smoke harness? e.g. `curl -s -X POST https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/api/playground -d '{"example":"summary-cost"}'`
preview-bot: PR 8122 preview: render-check failed (snippet runtime exception)
Nora (SDK): PR 8130 opened: updated examples for node/python/go, added the YAML diff, and inserted a short comment in code samples showing both keys for clarity. Node snippet example added:
```js
// prefer 'summary.cost' but fallback to 'cost_summary' for older runtimes
const payload = getDashboardPayload();
const cost = payload.summary?.cost ?? payload.cost_summary;
console.log(cost);
```
Harper (Docs): also found two doc links that point to `/console/observability/old-playground` — those are internal-only pages and break previews. can we make them relative (../playground) in the repo?
Samir (Platform): yes, please convert absolute links to relative. preview cluster blocks outbound calls and the hardcoded domain causes flakiness in preview tests.
Dmitri (Eng-Obs): i've added a tiny grep-and-replace in my PR to fix the links and remove the orphaned sample file `examples/legacy/cost_summary.yaml`.
Jules (QA): smoke after merge: `HTTP 200` and returned JSON shows `{ "summary": { "cost": { "total": 200, "breakdown": { "cpu": 150, "gpu": 50 } } } }` — no stack traces.
Harper (Docs): great, i'll merge once CI is green. follow-up: add a one-line note in the migration guide titled "cost_summary -> summary.cost" with the sed command for repos: `grep -R "cost_summary" -n | cut -d: -f1 | xargs sed -i "s/cost_summary/summary.cost/g"`
Nora (SDK): thanks — i'll also add a short compatibility note in the SDK CHANGELOG about the dual-key lookup for the next two releases.
Samir (Platform): i'll schedule a quick docs-housekeeping ticket to sweep for other legacy redirects next week.
Harper (Docs): merging and closing the block. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
